title: Token file — the shared shape a conforming design system emits
$comment: How a token is EXPRESSED, not what it is. Generalised from ls-design-system's generated token files, which is the only place this shape has been proven. Holds no colour values and mandates no role -> value mapping — see contract/vocabulary.json. Deliberately permissive about extra keys: an implementation is expected to carry its own metadata, and a contract that forbade that would be a straitjacket rather than a floor.

$value.description: The resolved, ready-to-use value, or the literal CSS declaration (var()/oklch()/color-mix()). A consumer must never have to compute this.

css.description: The custom property this token IS. The contract is that a token and its CSS variable are the same thing under two names.

source.description: Provenance. Where this value came from — ideally file:line. A token whose origin cannot be stated is a token nobody can safely change.

exactSeed.description: True for the verbatim brand hex that is never laddered.

modes.description: Present ONLY when the token differs between light and dark. Absent means mode-agnostic — which is the common case, and should stay that way: dark mode is a Tier 2 inversion, not a per-token variant.

derived.description: Set when the value is computed rather than authored. `from` should name a real token id in the same system.
